question: Who proclaimed the formation of a provisional government of the Azad Hind on October 21, 1943?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Subhash Chandra Bose.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• On** 21 October 1943,** Bose announced the formation of the** Provisional Government of Azad Hind (Free India).**
 
• He announced himself as the** Head of State, Prime Minister, and Minister of War.**
 
• The Provisional Government enabled Bose to negotiate with the Japanese on an equal footing.
 
• It also facilitated the mobilization of Indians in East Asia to join and support the INA.
 
• Soon after the announcement, the Provisional Government received recognition from various countries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Azad Hind was established as part of a political movement originating outside India by Indians against British imperialism.
 
• Subhash Chandra Bose was the most prominent leader of this movement.
 
• Azad Hind staked **claim to the entire subcontinent as its own.**
 
• In actuality, it governed Indian military and civilian personnel in the Southeast Asian British colonial territory. 
 
• The provisional Indian government was recognized only by the **Axis powers** and their allies.
